domains.name: Casino Games of Chance
domains.promise: Members wager play-money coins across the full advertised casino floor — coinflip, slots, roulette, blackjack, dice, rock-paper-scissors, scratch cards, guess-the-number, and the free high-low — with every outcome drawn from the project CSPRNG for uniform, tamper-resistant fairness. Owner-configurable per-game wager caps and a per-member daily loss cap keep stakes real but recoverable, a per-user lock makes concurrent bets safe, and losses are tracked in a restart-durable daily counter. It is all the fake game economy forever: no bet, payout, or jackpot ever touches real money, casino winnings are never convertible to the real paid store, and commerce-held roles earn no casino income.

controls.description: Master switch for the casino, backed by the economy_games_enabled config key; when off, every casino command replies that mini-games are disabled and no wager is accepted.
Maximum play-money coins wagerable per bet on economy_coinflip_max_bet-governed games (coinflip, roulette, dice, rock-paper-scissors, scratch, and guess all share this cap in code).
Maximum play-money coins wagerable per /slots spin, backed by the economy_slots_max_bet config key.
Maximum play-money coins wagerable per /blackjack hand, backed by the economy_blackjack_max_bet config key (a double-down can stake up to twice this at resolution).

Maximum net play-money coins a single member may lose per UTC day across all casino games, backed by the economy_daily_loss_limit config key; zero disables the cap. Enforced against the restart-durable economy_daily_losses counter.

defaults.rationale: The casino floor is a flagship game-economy draw and ships on for the maximal out-of-box experience; owners can switch it off in one click.
A conservative default table limit keeps early wagers small and losses recoverable; owners raise it freely as their economy matures.
Slots swing hard on a jackpot symbol, so the default cap matches the conservative coinflip limit to keep variance friendly for casual players.
Blackjack rewards skill and can double down, so it ships with a modestly higher default cap than the pure-chance games while staying conservative.
A sane non-zero daily loss ceiling protects members from grinding their whole wallet away in one session while leaving plenty of room for a fun run; owners can raise, lower, or disable it.

permissions.enforcement: Casino slash commands respond for every member; each bet only ever mutates the invoking member's own economy_wallets row, and a per-user Valkey lock (SET NX PX, fail-closed) permits at most one in-flight bet per member.

permissions.actor: Dashboard user with owner or admin access to the guild
permissions.action: Edit casino settings (enable flag, per-game wager caps, daily loss cap) on the dashboard economy games page
permissions.enforcement: Dashboard session auth plus Supabase RLS restrict guild_config writes to authorized guild administrators; the API validates each economy_* key before persisting.

permissions.action: Wager from or receive a payout into another member's play-money wallet
permissions.enforcement: Every economy_add_balance and economy_subtract_balance call is keyed to the invoking member's own guild and user id; no code path debits or credits another member's wallet from a casino command.

permissions.action: Convert casino play-money winnings into real-store credit, commerce entitlements, or any real-money value
permissions.enforcement: The casino reads and writes only economy_wallets and economy_daily_losses; there is no code path from a casino payout to the commerce or billing tables, and commerce-held roles grant no casino income.

messages.trigger: A casino bet resolves in the member's favor and the play-money payout lands
messages.surface: Channel embed replying to the casino command
messages.audience: The betting member and the channel
messages.defaultTemplate: {member-name} wins {payout} play coins on {game-name}! It's all house play money — good luck on the next one.

messages.trigger: A casino bet resolves against the member and the play-money stake is deducted
messages.surface: Channel embed replying to the casino command
messages.audience: The betting member and the channel
messages.defaultTemplate: {member-name} lost {stake} play coins on {game-name}. It's pretend money — the wallet refills, the fun stays.

messages.trigger: A member wagers more than the configured per-game maximum bet
messages.surface: Ephemeral reply to the invoking member
messages.defaultTemplate: That's over the table limit — the most you can wager here is {max-bet} play coins.

messages.trigger: A member's play-money losses for the UTC day would exceed the daily loss cap
messages.surface: Ephemeral reply to the invoking member
messages.defaultTemplate: You've reached today's play-coin loss limit, {member-name} — come back after the daily reset.

messages.trigger: A member starts a second casino bet while one is still resolving
messages.surface: Ephemeral reply to the invoking member
messages.defaultTemplate: You already have a game in progress, {member-name} — finish it first.

messages.trigger: The play-money debit on a losing bet fails so the balance is left unchanged
messages.surface: Ephemeral reply to the invoking member
messages.defaultTemplate: Something hiccuped and your bet didn't go through, {member-name} — your play-coin balance is untouched.

messages.trigger: The casino backend (Supabase or the Valkey lock) is temporarily unreachable when a member runs a casino command
messages.surface: Ephemeral reply to the invoking member
messages.defaultTemplate: The casino floor is briefly closed, {member-name} — give it a moment and try again. No coins moved.

messages.trigger: A winning play-money payout keeps failing after the outcome resolved
messages.defaultTemplate: Heads up: the {game-name} payout to {member-name} failed and is queued for operator retry; no play coins were double-paid and everything is logged.

values.description: The member has no in-flight bet; casino commands are ready within the configured wager and daily-loss caps.
A bet passed validation and holds the member's per-user Valkey lock while the CSPRNG outcome resolves (including an interactive blackjack collector).
The member's play-money losses reached the daily-loss cap; further wagers are refused until the UTC day rolls over.
A wallet RPC failed after a winning outcome; the member's balance is unchanged, the payout is queued for operator retry, and the member was told nothing was lost.
The casino is disabled by configuration; every casino command explains mini-games are off and no wager is accepted.

transitions.trigger: A member runs a casino command with a wager within the per-game max bet and their balance
transitions.expectedEffect: The per-user Valkey lock is acquired and the bet is validated exactly once against the enable flag, the max bet, the balance, and the daily-loss cap before any coins move.

transitions.trigger: The CSPRNG outcome resolves and the play-money wallet is adjusted
transitions.expectedEffect: Exactly one wallet mutation applies (credit on a win, debit on a loss), the daily-loss counter increments only on a real net loss, and the per-user lock is released in the finally block.

transitions.trigger: A member attempts a bet whose potential loss would push their UTC-day losses past the daily-loss cap
transitions.expectedEffect: The bet is refused before any coins move, the lock is released, and the member is told they hit today's loss limit.

transitions.trigger: The UTC day rolls over so a fresh economy_daily_losses counter starts at zero
transitions.expectedEffect: Wagering resumes under the same caps with the prior day's losses no longer counting against the member.

transitions.trigger: The winning-payout economy_add_balance RPC fails while resolving a bet
transitions.expectedEffect: The balance is left unchanged, no daily-loss increment is recorded for a win, the member is told nothing was lost, and the lock is released.

transitions.trigger: The queued payout is retried by the operator after the transient fault clears
transitions.expectedEffect: The owed winnings are credited exactly once under a single idempotency key; the member is never double-paid and never zero-paid.

transitions.trigger: Owner turns casino-enabled (economy_games_enabled) off on the dashboard
transitions.expectedEffect: Casino commands reply with the disabled explanation and accept no wagers; every wallet and daily-loss row is preserved untouched.
Casino play resumes under the configured caps with all balances and daily-loss counters intact.

failures.trigger: economy_add_balance fails after a casino outcome resolved in the member's favor
failures.expectedBehavior: The member's balance is left unchanged rather than falsely credited, the result surface plainly flags the delayed payout instead of pretending success, no daily-loss increment is recorded for the win, and the payout is queued for operator retry under one idempotency key so a retry credits exactly once.

failures.trigger: economy_subtract_balance fails while deducting the stake on a losing bet
failures.expectedBehavior: The wallet is left byte-identical, no daily-loss increment is recorded (the counter advances only after a successful debit), the member is told the bet did not go through, and the per-user lock is released so play can continue.

failures.trigger: Supabase or the Valkey lock is unreachable when a member runs a casino command
failures.expectedBehavior: The command fails safe with the branded casino-unavailable reply and no coins move; the per-user lock fails closed rather than double-granting, and the next healthy command resolves normally with exactly one wallet mutation.

assertions.expectedObservation: A seeded /coinflip 200 and /slots 200 each move run-member-a's wallet by exactly 200 in the resolved direction, a /coinflip 600 is refused with the over-max-bet reply, and a losing streak's deductions accumulate toward the 5000 daily loss cap with no real-money surface anywhere.
